# Quiet Path Living

> Quiet Path Living is a small handmade home-decor shop by designer Annika. It offers affirmation tags, framed verse signs, evening poetry prints, original watercolor art prints, songbird and woodland cottage bedding, heirloom tabletop decor, and printable PDF downloads. All products are sold through the Etsy shop: https://www.etsy.com/shop/QuietPathLiving

## Collections
- Morning Rituals: coffee-bar affirmation tags, framed signs and botanical teapot watercolor prints
- Bedside & Rest: evening poetry prints, nightstand cards, and cotton-linen bedding and pillowcases featuring Annika's hand-painted songbird and woodland designs
- Tabletop & Vintage: heirloom place cards, decorative display plates, quilted coverlets and watercolor prints
- Digital Studio: instant-download printable PDFs for 5x7 and 8x10 cardstock

## Buying
- Purchases, custom orders and instant downloads are handled on Etsy.
- Custom verses and monograms can be requested through Etsy or the contact form on quietpathliving.com.
- Discount code QUIET15 gives 15% off on Etsy.
